d:
Jharkhand Vidhansabha men neta pratipaksh Babulal Marandi ne SIR ko bataya sanvaidhanik prakiya, kaha ye
Jharkhand ke neta pratipaksh aur bhajpa neta babulal marandi ne SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ko lekar bara bayan diya hai. unhonne SIR ko ek sanvaidhanik prakriya batate hue iska samarthan kiya. babulal marandi ne is dauran kya kuchh kaha aur SIR ko lekar unka kya tark hai? dekhie is khas riport men.
